value.rationale: A canonical finite truncation of Abelian-cube avoidance exhibits a sharp growth collapse: the period-one-only language has exponentially many words (avoidance of three equal bits), but adding period two leaves exactly ten or twelve at each sufficiently large length and only six bi-infinite sequences. The classification explains the mod-three fluctuations and zero entropy and gives a complete natural short-period boundary without needing a new unrestricted avoidability result.
